They are based in the town of [[Béziers]] and their home stadium is the Stade de Sauclières. The idea to merge the three football teams in order to have a championship team came in 2006, but a [[Championnat de France amateur]] (CFA) team was not created until 2007. Béziers won promotion to professional football in 2017–18 for the first time, and played in [[Ligue 2]] for one season. As of the 2023–24 season it plays in [[Régional 1]], after several recent relegations on and off the field."}}
